cards.example_en: A white rabbit hopped across the grass towards us.
cards.example_zh: 一只白兔蹦蹦跳跳地穿过草地，朝我们跑来。
cards.explain_zh: rabbit泛指兔；hare通常指腿耳更长的野兔。

cards.example_en: Thanks for helping me carry these heavy bags upstairs.
cards.example_zh: 谢谢你帮我把这些沉重的袋子搬上楼。
cards.explain_zh: thanks for后接名词或动名词；thanks to表示多亏。

cards.example_en: She hung a clean towel beside the bathroom sink.
cards.example_zh: 她在浴室洗手池旁挂了一条干净毛巾。
cards.explain_zh: 美式英语中bathroom也可指没有浴缸的厕所。

cards.example_en: She hung a clean towel beside the bathroom sink.
cards.example_zh: 她在浴室洗手池旁挂了一条干净毛巾。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My cousin moved to Australia to study marine biology.
cards.example_zh: 我的表亲搬到澳大利亚学习海洋生物学。
cards.explain_zh: Australia指澳大利亚；Austria才是奥地利。

cards.example_en: My cousin spent three months travelling around Asia.
cards.example_zh: 我表亲花了三个月在亚洲各地旅行。
cards.explain_zh: 洲名首字母大写，通常不加the；形容词为Asian。

cards.example_en: What colour should we paint the kitchen walls?
cards.example_zh: 我们该把厨房的墙刷成什么颜色？
cards.explain_zh: 英式拼写为colour，美式为color。

cards.example_en: I packed a clean T-shirt for the picnic.
cards.example_zh: 我为野餐带了一件干净的T恤衫。
cards.explain_zh: 可数名词，复数为 T-shirts，保留连字符。

cards.example_en: Choosing a durable cotton T-shirt instead of disposable fashion can reduce waste and encourage more responsible consumption.
cards.example_zh: 选择耐穿的棉质T恤衫而非一次性时尚服饰，可以减少浪费并促进更负责任的消费。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: This delicious vegetable pie is still warm from the oven.
cards.example_zh: 这份美味的蔬菜派刚出炉，还热乎着。
cards.explain_zh: delicious本身语气较强，常用absolutely加强。

cards.example_en: We explored ancient ruins during our holiday in Mexico.
cards.example_zh: 我们在墨西哥度假期间探访了古代遗址。
cards.explain_zh: 国名前通常不加the；Mexican指墨西哥的或墨西哥人。

cards.example_en: A grey cat was sleeping on the windowsill.
cards.example_zh: 一只灰猫正在窗台上睡觉。
cards.explain_zh: grey为英式拼写，gray为美式拼写。

cards.example_en: Hey, you left your umbrella beside the door!
cards.example_zh: 喂，你把伞落在门边了！
cards.explain_zh: 适合熟人间打招呼；正式邮件避免使用。

cards.example_en: He poured cold cola into a glass with ice.
cards.example_zh: 他把冰可乐倒进一个放了冰块的玻璃杯。
cards.explain_zh: 泛指饮料时不可数；a cola可指一杯或一份可乐。

cards.example_en: These strawberries smell lovely, so let's buy a basket.
cards.example_zh: 这些草莓闻起来很香，我们买一篮吧。
cards.explain_zh: these是this的复数，后接复数名词。

cards.example_en: This little bakery sells my favourite kind of bread.
cards.example_zh: 这家小面包店卖我最喜欢的那种面包。
cards.explain_zh: 英式拼写favourite，美式favorite；一般不用most修饰。

cards.example_en: I went downstairs when I smelled fresh bread.
cards.example_zh: 闻到新鲜面包的香味后，我下了楼。
cards.explain_zh: 作副词时直接说go downstairs，不加to。

cards.example_en: Our teacher drew a huge circle on the blackboard.
cards.example_zh: 老师在黑板上画了一个大圆圈。
cards.explain_zh: 在黑板上用on the blackboard；配合粉笔使用。

cards.example_en: We had a picnic under a shady tree.
cards.example_zh: 我们在一棵树的荫凉下野餐。
cards.explain_zh: 动词过去式为picnicked，进行形式为picnicking。

cards.example_en: She warmed her hands around a bowl of soup.
cards.example_zh: 她双手捧着一碗汤取暖。
cards.explain_zh: 通常不可数；点餐时two soups可指两份汤。

cards.example_en: We shared a sandwich at the cafe beside the station.
cards.example_zh: 我们在车站旁的小餐馆分着吃了一份三明治。
cards.explain_zh: 也写作café；通常提供饮料和简餐。

cards.example_en: I called her after lunch to arrange a walk.
cards.example_zh: 午饭后我给她打了电话，约好一起散步。
cards.explain_zh: her可作宾语或接名词表所属；hers独立使用。

cards.example_en: My cousin moved to Germany to study engineering.
cards.example_zh: 我的表亲搬到德国去学工程了。
cards.explain_zh: Germany是国名；German可指德语、德国人或德国的。

cards.example_en: This swimming class is perfect for a complete beginner.
cards.example_zh: 这堂游泳课非常适合完全没有基础的初学者。
cards.explain_zh: beginner是可数名词，单数前通常要有限定词。

cards.example_en: This swimming class is perfect for a complete beginner.
cards.example_zh: 这堂游泳课非常适合完全没有基础的初学者。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: This backpack is better than my old one.
cards.example_zh: 这个背包比我原来的那个好。
cards.explain_zh: 是good和well的比较级，不说more better。

cards.example_en: This backpack is better than my old one.
cards.example_zh: 这个背包比我原来的那个好。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I locked my bicycle outside the small bakery.
cards.example_zh: 我把自行车锁在那家小面包店外面。
cards.explain_zh: by bicycle不加冠词；ride a bicycle要加冠词。

cards.example_en: Travelling by bicycle can reduce urban air pollution while providing residents with regular physical exercise.
cards.example_zh: 骑自行车出行既能减少城市空气污染，也能让居民经常锻炼身体。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The temperature fell below zero while we were sleeping.
cards.example_zh: 我们睡觉时，气温降到了零度以下。
cards.explain_zh: 读电话号码时零也常读作oh；温度用zero。

cards.example_en: The temperature fell below zero while we were sleeping.
cards.example_zh: 我们睡觉时，气温降到了零度以下。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My cousin moved to Canada to study environmental science.
cards.example_zh: 我的表亲搬到加拿大去学习环境科学。
cards.explain_zh: 国名首字母大写，前面通常不加the。

cards.example_en: My cousin moved to America to study engineering.
cards.example_zh: 我的表亲搬到美国去学工程。
cards.explain_zh: 日常多指美国；南北美洲合称常用the Americas。

cards.example_en: We travelled through Sweden by train last summer.
cards.example_zh: 去年夏天，我们乘火车游览了瑞典。
cards.explain_zh: Sweden是瑞典；Switzerland才是瑞士。

cards.example_en: We travelled along the coast of Portugal by train.
cards.example_zh: 我们乘火车沿葡萄牙海岸旅行。
cards.explain_zh: 国名前通常不加the；Portuguese指葡语或葡萄牙的。

cards.example_en: We travelled along the coast of Portugal by train.
cards.example_zh: 我们乘火车沿葡萄牙海岸旅行。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: He wore a purple scarf with his grey coat.
cards.example_zh: 他穿着灰色外套，围了一条紫色围巾。
cards.explain_zh: purple可作形容词或名词；purplish表示“略带紫色的”。

cards.example_en: Garden designers often combine purple flowers with yellow varieties to create a striking visual contrast.
cards.example_zh: 花园设计师常将紫色花卉与黄色品种搭配，形成鲜明的视觉反差。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: In geography today, we learned how rivers shape valleys.
cards.example_zh: 今天的地理课上，我们学习了河流如何塑造河谷。
cards.explain_zh: geography是地理学；geology是地质学。

cards.example_en: Three women were planting flowers in the shared garden.
cards.example_zh: 三位女性正在公共花园里种花。
cards.explain_zh: woman的复数；首音节读/wɪ/，不是/wʊ/。

cards.example_en: A feeling of relief washed over me after the exam.
cards.example_zh: 考试结束后，我顿时感到如释重负。
cards.explain_zh: feelings常指感情；have a feeling that表示直觉。

cards.example_en: A feeling of relief washed over me after the exam.
cards.example_zh: 考试结束后，我顿时感到如释重负。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My cousin lives in a quiet village in England.
cards.example_zh: 我的表亲住在英格兰一个安静的村庄里。
cards.explain_zh: England仅指英格兰，不等于整个英国。

cards.example_en: Our apartment building has a garden on the roof.
cards.example_zh: 我们住的公寓楼屋顶上有一个花园。
cards.explain_zh: 指建筑物时可数，指建造活动时通常不可数。

cards.example_en: We ate breakfast on the sunny balcony this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上，我们在阳光充足的阳台上吃了早餐。
cards.explain_zh: sunny强调阳光足，不一定表示气温高。

cards.example_en: I left my glasses beside the bed last night.
cards.example_zh: 我昨晚把眼镜落在床边了。
cards.explain_zh: 指眼镜时用复数；一副眼镜用a pair of glasses。

cards.example_en: We go swimming at the indoor pool every Saturday.
cards.example_zh: 我们每周六都去室内泳池游泳。
cards.explain_zh: 表示运动时不可数；去游泳用go swimming。

cards.example_en: We go swimming at the indoor pool every Saturday.
cards.example_zh: 我们每周六都去室内泳池游泳。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We travelled through Switzerland by train during our holiday.
cards.example_zh: 假期里，我们乘火车游览了瑞士。
cards.explain_zh: Switzerland 是瑞士，Sweden 是瑞典；瑞士的用 Swiss。

cards.example_en: Our team meeting starts right after lunch today.
cards.example_zh: 我们团队今天午饭后马上开会。
cards.explain_zh: 参加会议用attend a meeting；meeting也可指会面。

word.example_en: She warmed her hands around a bowl of soup.
word.example_zh: 她双手捧着一碗汤取暖。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Community kitchens can provide affordable vegetable soup to help residents access nutritious meals during difficult economic periods.
word.example_zh: 社区厨房可以提供价格实惠的蔬菜汤，帮助居民在经济困难时期获得有营养的餐食。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
